caption: The drawing depicts a single blue glass bottle with a narrow cylindrical neck and a rounded, bulbous base, centered within a rectangle on a plain, beige background. The neck of the bottle is smooth and straight, with a slightly flared, circular rim at the top. The body of the bottle features vertical, curved ridges that start from the shoulder and extend downwards, creating an alternating pattern of raised and indented areas. Around the lower part of the bottle, there is a decorative band of white stars evenly spaced against the blue glass. The shading varies in intensity, with darker blue indicating depth and lighter, almost white highlights used to represent reflections and give the object a glass-like appearance. The artist's signature is located in the lower right corner of the rectangular area surrounding the bottle.
title: Barber Shop Bottle
